name: Eyes on Earth — Sun-Sync Sentinel
description: Valid alternative high-capability spacecraft design. Demonstrates meaningful trade-offs: achieves superior scientific data quality and systematic global coverage via a Sun-Synchronous Orbit and Multispectral Imager at the expense of higher resource expenditure, remaining strictly within the $500,000 budget.
designRationale: Demonstrates that the game rewards diverse valid engineering trade-offs. By retaining the lightweight Small Satellite Bus ($25,000), the player saves sufficient funds to afford Launcher Beta ($230,000) and reach Sun-Synchronous Orbit (SSO-600). The Multispectral Imager (3.5 Mbps, 22 W) provides higher scientific yield than the basic optical camera, while the High-Efficiency Solar Array (140 W) and High-Capacity Battery Pack (320 Wh) easily sustain the increased electrical demand.
